articles.title: A researcher announced the creation of patterns designed to prevent detection by cameras
articles.description: Cybersecurity expert Bill Swiringen has developed the noRecognition project, which generates computer-generated patterns for clothing, objects, and vehicles. According to him, such patterns can prevent video surveillance systems from automatically detecting people, faces, objects, or vehicles.
